content: I tightened my belts using these pictures as a guide. They turned out to be so tight that the belt tension wizard didn't work. It took me a while to figure out that they needed to be loosened
Belts seem insanely tight - hope this works...

replies.content: Yeah belts feel tighter than a puckered end

I didn't tighten the belts this much (pre-GT1.5 belts needed far less) and had all sorts of trouble with belt calibration.  Tightened them up and bingo, calibration is fine.

Homing calibration still took forever but did at least work.  And I now finally have all four docks calibrated.  It only took half a day....
